metadata.title: Vocabulary through the end of Momente Lesson 3
metadata.scope: Official L1-L3 glossary, essential phrase components, picture lexicons, workbook practice, linked partner/extension tasks, Module 1 recognition vocabulary, and supplied 48-row teacher jobs handout. Excludes Lesson 4 onward, character names, city inventories, and publication text.

priority_definitions.Core: Roman-type glossary learning words and essential target-language components/picture-lexicon words for L1-L3.
priority_definitions.Context: Italic glossary words or extra bounded reading/example/Module 1 words; recognise first.
priority_definitions.Classroom: Activity instructions and study language; recognising an instruction does not make its full verb paradigm core grammar.
priority_definitions.Teacher extra: Additional forms from the supplied teacher jobs handout; overlaps remain under their earlier entry.

metadata.source_key: KB = coursebook; AB = workbook. Printed page numbers except explicitly labeled PDF. Relevant PDF pages = printed page + 2. Glossary page = PDF page.
metadata.plural_policy: Full definite-article plurals for count nouns; ordinary singular-only senses and plural-only names labeled. Empty strings for non-nouns. Plural forms are study expansions, not a claim that all plural grammar is taught before L4.
corrections: Correct Kellner plural is die Kellner, supported by the teacher handout.
Verwandte and Auszubildende have article-sensitive adjectival endings.
Chocolatière is context-only and its unverified plural has not been invented.

external_lexical_verification.use: Masculine Chocolatier and plural die Chocolatiers.

metadata.learning_advice: Learn Core entries and numbers actively. Recognise Context and Classroom entries; practise the teacher supplement if it was assigned. A word appearing in an instruction does not require mastering its complete conjugation or grammar by Lesson 3.
